intent_en: To demonstrate how a new business model increases Facebook's profits and consequently raises the value of its shares for shareholders.
previous_intent: To illustrate how a new business model can increase company profits and drive up share value, benefiting shareholders.
narration_support: Facebook is able to greatly increase its profits with a new business model... so will the value of its shares.
chart_support: Line chart showing an upward trend in value from 38€ to 50€.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly links a new business model to increased profits and share value (38 to 50 euros). The chart visualizes this upward trend with a line graph starting at 38€ and ending near 50€, supported by a calculator graphic.
